resource-calendar.title: Resource work calendar
resource-calendar.modal_help: Set planned availability for this project resource. Saving a calendar does not change tasks or execution slots.
resource-calendar.explainer: Planned hours come from each resource’s weekly calendar and date exceptions. Blank availability is unknown; 0 means a day off.
resource-calendar.semantics: Hours are planned availability, separate from actual work and execution slots. Blank means unknown; 0 explicitly means a day off. Use quarter hours from 0 to 24.
resource-calendar.weekly_hint: Monday through Sunday. Changes apply to this resource across planning weeks.
resource-calendar.exceptions_hint: An exception replaces the usual weekday. Leave its hours blank for unknown availability; remove it to inherit the usual week. Up to 366 dates.
resource-calendar.inherited: No date exceptions. Each date inherits its usual weekday, including unknown days and days off.
resource-calendar.unsaved: No calendar saved. All days are unknown.
resource-calendar.original_pending: The original save is awaiting confirmation. Recover its exact calendar and operation before making another change.
resource-calendar.access_changed: Your access has changed. Calendar details are hidden; check current access before editing.
resource-calendar.read_only: You can view this resource calendar. Editing requires current project management access.
resource-calendar.hours_invalid: Enter blank or quarter hours from 0 to 24 for every day.
resource-calendar.exceptions_limit: Keep no more than 366 date exceptions.
resource-calendar.date_invalid: Choose a valid date for every exception.
resource-calendar.date_duplicate: Use only one exception per date.
resource-calendar.note_invalid: Each reason must be valid text with no more than 200 characters.
resource-calendar.unscheduled: {{count}} tasks without a complete schedule in this resource’s project. Both start and due dates are required; this count is not additive across weeks.
resource-calendar.distribution_unknown: {{count}} tasks / {{hours}} estimated hours could not be distributed. This is their complete task estimate, not additional hours in this week. Their date span includes unknown availability or no available hours. Do not add this total across overlapping weeks.
resource-calendar.scope_notice: Week starting {{week}}. Estimates are distributed by available hours over each task’s complete date span. Unknown or zero total availability stays undistributed. These are planned estimates, not actual work or execution slots.
